answer: Agents secure entry by completing 1,000 unique data-custody shards, with each shard acting as a plume of evidence that requires non-replayable retrieval. A verifier checks these against a walnut of historic keys, ensuring zero overlap between identities. While an honest node spends 1,000 compute units, 1,000 fakes incur 1,000,000 units, creating a gale of economic pressure that renders sybil attacks ruinous.
